exposure: Birth mode (elective CS, emergency CS, vaginal delivery)
cohort: 4327 mother-offspring pairs from a longitudinal birth cohort study
finding: Birth mode was not significantly associated with offspring cognitive or academic performance at age 5, 14 or 21 years.
mod_finding: There was no statistically significant association between mode of delivery and cognitive outcomes at any age; however, at 5 years old, the adjusted mean difference in PPVT-R score for elective CS birth compared to vaginal delivery was -2.2 (95% CI -4.3 to -0.2), while the difference for emergency CS compared to vaginal delivery was not statistically significant.
